title: 1alpha,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D3 (VD3) Shows a Neuroprotective Action Against Rotenone Toxicity on PC12 Cells: An In Vitro Model of Parkinson's Disease.
authors: de Siqueira, Erlania Alves; Magalhaes, Emanuel Paula; de Assis, Albert Layo Costa; Sampaio, Tiago Lima; Lima, Danya Bandeira; Marinho, Marcia Machado; Martins, Alice Maria Costa; de Andrade, Geanne Matos; de Barros Viana, Glauce Socorro
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估维生素D3对鱼藤酮诱导PC12细胞毒性的神经保护作用，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is characterized by dopaminergic cell loss in the substantia nigra, and PD brains show neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial dysfunction. The study evaluated the neuroprotective activity of 1alpha,25-dihydroxy vitamin D3 (VD3), on the rotenone (ROT)-induced cytotoxicity in PC12 cells. The viability parameters were assessed by the MTT and flow cytometry, on cells treated or not with VD3 and/or ROT. Besides, ROS production, cell death, mitochondrial transmembrane potential, reduced GSH, superoxide accumulation, molecular docking (TH and Keap1-Nrf2), and TH, Nrf2, NF-kB, and VD3 receptor protein contents by western blot were evaluated. VD3 was shown to improve the viability of ROT-exposed cells. Cells exposed to ROT showed increased production of ROS and superoxide, which decreased after VD3. ROT decrease in the mitochondrial transmembrane potential was prevented, after VD3 treatment and, VD3 was shown to interact with tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) and Nrf2. While ROT decreased TH, Nrf2, and NF-kB expressions, these effects were reversed by VD3. In addition, VD3 also increased VD3 receptor protein contents and values went back to those of controls after ROT exposure. VD3 protects PC12 cells against ROT damage, by decreasing oxidative stress and improving mitochondrial function. One target seems to be the TH molecule and possibly an indirect Nrf2 activation could also justify its neuroprotective actions on this PC12 cell model of PD.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）以黑质中多巴胺能细胞丢失为特征，且PD脑内表现出神经炎症、氧化应激和线粒体功能障碍。本研究评估了1α,25-二羟基维生素D3（VD3）对鱼藤酮（rotenone, ROT）诱导的PC12细胞毒性的神经保护活性。通过MTT法和流式细胞术检测了经或未经VD3和/或ROT处理的细胞的活力参数。此外，还评估了ROS产生、细胞死亡、线粒体跨膜电位、还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）、超氧化物积累、分子对接（TH和Keap1-Nrf2），以及通过蛋白质印迹法检测的TH、Nrf2、NF-kB和VD3受体蛋白含量。结果显示，VD3能改善ROT暴露细胞的活力。暴露于ROT的细胞表现出ROS和超氧化物产生增加，而VD3处理后这些水平下降。VD3处理阻止了ROT引起的线粒体跨膜电位降低，并且VD3被证明能与酪氨酸羟化酶（tyrosine hydroxylase, TH）和Nrf2相互作用。虽然ROT降低了TH、Nrf2和NF-kB的表达，但这些效应被VD3逆转。此外，VD3还增加了VD3受体蛋白含量，且在ROT暴露后这些值恢复至对照组水平。VD3通过减少氧化应激和改善线粒体功能，保护PC12细胞免受ROT损伤。一个靶点似乎是TH分子，且可能的间接Nrf2激活也可能解释其在此PD的PC12细胞模型中的神经保护作用。
